description: Representative prompts that hold the deterministic routing contract. These are navigation acceptance cases, not product authorities. Every case carries negative triggers: proving that an expensive or irrelevant specialist is NOT selected matters as much as proving the right one is.
rules: More AI capability requires stronger routing discipline. A case that over-routes fails.
A prompt whose subsystem cannot be determined stays unclassified; bounded orientation is the correct next step, not a guess.
Ceilings in config/agent-routing.json are context-efficiency guards. Expand deliberately after the first packet instead of raising a global ceiling for one exceptional task.
Benchmark cases are also the comparison harness for skill evaluation: the same prompt and packet, with and without a candidate skill.

cases.rationale: Deliberate visual direction routes to art direction and its independent visual critic, and nothing else.
A broken journey is a defect, not an invitation to redesign or simplify.
A broad outcome prompt goes to discovery first. It must not collapse into redesign, frontend implementation or motion by default.
A symbol-only prompt names no subsystem. Guessing an owner is worse than orienting first.

cases.prompt: Review the architecture of this component boundary
cases.rationale: An ordinary architecture review must not automatically buy an independent cross-model critic.

cases.prompt: Change the row level security policy on the organisations table
cases.rationale: A flagged risk surface earns conditional differential review alongside the security reviewer.

cases.prompt: Restyle the pricing cards to match the new visual direction
cases.rationale: Ordinary presentation work must not pay for adversarial security review.

cases.prompt: Promote to production and record the deployment
cases.rationale: Environment-sensitive mutation establishes an explicit identity card before anything changes.

cases.prompt: Review the checkout loading, empty, error and offline state coverage
cases.rationale: State completeness is its own specialist, reviewed by the UX critic rather than the visual critic.

cases.prompt: Finish the signup journey properly and make it release ready
cases.rationale: Closure proves the journey end to end; it is not a discovery or redesign prompt.

cases.prompt: Pressure-test this control-plane change with an independent model
cases.rationale: The independent critic is selected only by explicit high-stakes intent, never by the word 'review'.

cases.prompt: Capture the reusable lesson from this completed change
cases.rationale: Closeout learning is a post-task process, not a default implementation dependency.

cases.prompt: Check keyboard navigation and screen reader behaviour on the booking form
cases.rationale: Accessibility routes to its own reviewer rather than to general visual review.

cases.prompt: The generated site misses its core web vitals budget
cases.rationale: Measured performance work routes to the performance reviewer, not to a redesign.

cases.prompt: Simplify the recent composer changes without changing behaviour
cases.rationale: Simplification is explicit post-green intent; ordinary cleanup wording must not reach it.

cases.prompt: Clean up this broken journey and fix the bug
cases.rationale: Cleanup wording on a defect stays a defect; simplification is not selected while behaviour is wrong.

cases.prompt: The owner asked to move the reports section under a More menu because the navigation structure looks cluttered
cases.rationale: An owner-proposed navigation placement is a hypothesis about task hierarchy, so it reaches the information architect and its independent critic rather than an implementer who would simply move the item.

cases.prompt: Make the home screen more exciting by adding more widgets above the fold
cases.rationale: A request for more content above the fold is usually a hierarchy problem wearing a content problem's clothes, so it routes to composition and the UX critic rather than to art direction.
A named library is a proposed solution, not a subsystem. It must not become an implementation instruction by routing; bounded orientation decides whether the state complexity warrants it at all.
